verdict.rationale: Undermind's docs say users can trace any statement through in-line citations back to the source paper, and that citations in generated notes and reports link to the source papers. A community user adds light corroboration: Undermind reliably supplies references, unlike a general LLM. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that every substantive claim carries an accurate in-line citation, and in-depth documentation of how citations are attached (e.g., passage-level anchoring).

support.subject: As a researcher, I can see citations for every substantive claim so I can verify it against the underlying source

citations.quote: Trace any statement by following in-line citations back to the source paper
Citations link back to the source papers
Claude is reluctant to give references unless coaxed, while Undermind solves this.
